'''Coratanni''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] of the [[Ravagers]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Born into the [[Nova Blades]], she was never taken seriously by other pirates, who saw her as more suitable for trading than pillaging. Eventually deciding to leave her family, Coratanni hid on a ship departing [[Raider's Cove]]. However, the vessel was boarded by far more bloodthirsty [[Ravagers]] pirates, though Coratanni defended herself so fiercely that she was offered a place in the gang.<ref name="Codex" /> Finding her place with the Ravagers, Coratanni was eventually backstabbed by the captain [[Ruugar]]. However, she again prevailed, slicing off his fight arm and leg and tossing him overboard to hungry [[Skar'kla]]s. Becoming the new captain of the Ravagers, she renamed their base Ruugaria into [[Coratanni Town]]. Unfortunately for her, Ruugar survived and years later hired a group to inflict his revenge on Coratanni. The group boarded the vessel ''[[Soaring Duros]]'' and engaged Coratanni's flagship ''[[Pearl's Girl]]'' in combat, eventually reaching Coratanni herself. The woman and her pet [[Mantellian flutterplume/Legends|flutterplume]] [[Pearl (flutterplume)|Pearl]] fought fiercely, but were defeated and killed. However, Ruugar didn't live long enough to celebrate, as he betrayed his associates immediately after Coratanni's death and was killed in return.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Coratanni appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion, released on [[December 2]], [[2014]].
